Core `v0.1.9` has `OpenShell.BeginRootfsTarStaging`, a user-facing RPC that the Go SDK does not wrap yet. First seen in core `v0.1.9`.

**Buildable on `main`**: the generated bindings on the SDK's `main` already contain every method listed here.

## `OpenShell.BeginRootfsTarStaging`

Allocate a gateway-owned staging slot for a local rootfs tar archive.

The gateway creates a request-scoped directory inside the compute driver's
staging root and returns an opaque single-use token plus the absolute path
the client must write the archive to. The token is then passed as
`template.driver_config.<driver>.rootfs_tar_staging_token` on
CreateSandbox; callers never name a filesystem path themselves. Only a
client sharing the gateway's filesystem can complete the upload.

- Streaming: unary
- Authorization: `bearer`, scope `sandbox:write`, workspace role `user`
- Definition: [`proto/openshell.proto`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/proto/openshell.proto#L64-L71) at core `v0.1.9`
- Generated bindings on the SDK's `main`: yes

```proto
rpc BeginRootfsTarStaging(BeginRootfsTarStagingRequest)
    returns (BeginRootfsTarStagingResponse) {
  option (openshell.options.v1.authorization) = {
    auth_mode: "bearer"
    scope: "sandbox:write"
    workspace_role: "user"
  };
}
```

Request and response messages:

```proto
message BeginRootfsTarStagingRequest {
  // Workspace scope. Only a named workspace selection is accepted.
  openshell.datamodel.v1.WorkspaceSelector workspace_scope = 3;
  // Base file name of the local archive. The gateway uses it only to name the
  // staged file; path separators and traversal components are rejected.
  string file_name = 1;
  // Size of the local archive in bytes, checked against the driver limit
  // before the gateway allocates a slot.
  uint64 size_bytes = 2;
}
```

```proto
message BeginRootfsTarStagingResponse {
  reserved 4;
  reserved "expires_at_ms";
  // Opaque single-use token. Pass it as
  // `template.driver_config.<driver>.rootfs_tar_staging_token` on
  // CreateSandbox. The first CreateSandbox presenting it consumes it.
  string staging_token = 1;
  // Absolute path on the gateway host the client must write the archive to.
  string upload_path = 2;
  // Maximum accepted archive size in bytes, enforced again by the driver.
  uint64 max_bytes = 3;
  // Wall-clock deadline after which the gateway reclaims the slot.
  google.protobuf.Timestamp expiration_time = 104;
}
```

## Where core implements it

### `OpenShell.BeginRootfsTarStaging`

- Server (`crates/openshell-server/src`): [`crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/mod.rs`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/mod.rs)
- Rust SDK (`crates/openshell-sdk/src`): not found
- TypeScript SDK (`sdk/typescript/src`): not found

Core `v0.1.9` has a user-facing method in the `SandboxUpdates` service that the Go SDK does not wrap yet: `UpdateSandbox`. The SDK wraps none of the service's user-facing methods, so this issue tracks the service as a whole. First seen in core `v0.1.9`.

**Buildable on `main`**: the generated bindings on the SDK's `main` already contain every method listed here.

## `SandboxUpdates.UpdateSandbox`

Update the workload image, command, environment, labels, or annotations of a
stopped sandbox while preserving its identity and retained storage. Requires
compute-driver support for the selected changes and explicit gateway activation
of sandbox updates.

- Streaming: unary
- Authorization: `bearer`, scope `sandbox:write`, workspace role `user`
- Definition: [`proto/openshell.proto`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/proto/openshell.proto#L890-L896) at core `v0.1.9`
- Generated bindings on the SDK's `main`: yes

```proto
rpc UpdateSandbox(UpdateSandboxRequest) returns (SandboxResponse) {
  option (openshell.options.v1.authorization) = {
    auth_mode: "bearer"
    scope: "sandbox:write"
    workspace_role: "user"
  };
}
```

Request and response messages:

```proto
message SandboxResponse {
  Sandbox sandbox = 1;
  // Service URLs created by CreateSandbox, keyed by service name. The empty
  // key identifies the unnamed service. Other sandbox RPCs return an empty map.
  map<string, string> service_urls = 2;
}
```

```proto
message UpdateSandboxRequest {
  // Workspace scope. Only a named workspace selection is accepted.
  openshell.datamodel.v1.WorkspaceSelector workspace_scope = 1;
  // Canonical name of the existing sandbox; this is not a rename or upsert.
  string name = 2;
  // Nonempty OCI workload image reference. This does not change trusted runtime
  // images or reseed an existing workspace.
  optional string image = 3;
  // Replace workload argv; an empty list restores image-resolved default shell behavior.
  SandboxCommandUpdate command = 6;
  // Replace sandbox-level overrides. Empty clears overrides; template defaults remain.
  SandboxMapUpdate environment = 7;
  // Replace user metadata, preserving gateway-owned keys. These do not set pod metadata.
  SandboxMapUpdate labels = 8;
  SandboxMapUpdate annotations = 9;
  // Required nonzero resource version read by the caller.
  uint64 expected_resource_version = 4;
  // Optional nonzero UUID for durable at-most-once admission.
  string request_id = 5;
}
```

<!-- rpc-coverage: kind=service service=ServiceDiscovery first-seen=v0.1.9 methods=GetServiceRouteSnapshot,WatchServiceRoutes -->

Core `v0.1.9` has 2 user-facing methods in the `ServiceDiscovery` service that the Go SDK does not wrap yet: `GetServiceRouteSnapshot` and `WatchServiceRoutes`. The SDK wraps none of the service's user-facing methods, so this issue tracks the service as a whole. First seen in core `v0.1.9`.

**Blocked on the core bump**: the generated bindings on the SDK's `main` do not contain every method listed here yet. Work on the bump branch [`core/v0.1.9`](https://github.com/ai-openshell/sdk-go/tree/core/v0.1.9), or on `main` once that proposal is merged.

## `ServiceDiscovery.GetServiceRouteSnapshot`

Read installed, unexpired application routes in one explicit workspace.

- Streaming: unary
- Authorization: `bearer`, scope `sandbox:read`, workspace role `user`
- Definition: [`proto/openshell.proto`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/proto/openshell.proto#L864-L870) at core `v0.1.9`
- Generated bindings on the SDK's `main`: no

```proto
rpc GetServiceRouteSnapshot(GetServiceRouteSnapshotRequest) returns (GetServiceRouteSnapshotResponse) {
  option (openshell.options.v1.authorization) = {
    auth_mode: "bearer"
    scope: "sandbox:read"
    workspace_role: "user"
  };
}
```

Request and response messages:

```proto
message GetServiceRouteSnapshotRequest {
  openshell.datamodel.v1.WorkspaceSelector workspace_scope = 1;
}
```

```proto
message GetServiceRouteSnapshotResponse {
  ServiceRouteSnapshot snapshot = 1;
}
```

## `ServiceDiscovery.WatchServiceRoutes`

Full replacement views; reauthorize during the bounded watch lifetime.

- Streaming: server streaming
- Authorization: `bearer`, scope `sandbox:read`, workspace role `user`
- Definition: [`proto/openshell.proto`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/proto/openshell.proto#L873-L879) at core `v0.1.9`
- Generated bindings on the SDK's `main`: no

```proto
rpc WatchServiceRoutes(WatchServiceRoutesRequest) returns (stream WatchServiceRoutesResponse) {
  option (openshell.options.v1.authorization) = {
    auth_mode: "bearer"
    scope: "sandbox:read"
    workspace_role: "user"
  };
}
```

Request and response messages:

```proto
message WatchServiceRoutesRequest {
  openshell.datamodel.v1.WorkspaceSelector workspace_scope = 1;
}
```

```proto
message WatchServiceRoutesResponse {
  ServiceRouteSnapshot snapshot = 1;
}
```

## Where core implements it

### `ServiceDiscovery.GetServiceRouteSnapshot`

- Server (`crates/openshell-server/src`): [`crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/mod.rs`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/mod.rs), [`crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/service_discovery.rs`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/service_discovery.rs)
- Rust SDK (`crates/openshell-sdk/src`): not found
- TypeScript SDK (`sdk/typescript/src`): not found

### `ServiceDiscovery.WatchServiceRoutes`

- Server (`crates/openshell-server/src`): [`crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/mod.rs`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/mod.rs), [`crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/service_discovery.rs`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/service_discovery.rs)
- Rust SDK (`crates/openshell-sdk/src`): not found
- TypeScript SDK (`sdk/typescript/src`): not found

## Implementation brief

Copy this block as the task description when you start the work.

````text
Wrap the ServiceDiscovery service of OpenShell core in the OpenShell Go SDK (https://github.com/ai-openshell/sdk-go): methods GetServiceRouteSnapshot, WatchServiceRoutes.

Core version: NVIDIA/OpenShell at tag v0.1.9.
Branch: start from core/v0.1.9, the core bump proposal for v0.1.9; the bindings on main do not contain the methods yet.

Read first:
- AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md in the SDK repository: conventions, commands, and commit rules.
- ServiceDiscovery.GetServiceRouteSnapshot: proto definition https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/proto/openshell.proto#L864-L870; core server: https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/mod.rs, https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/service_discovery.rs
- ServiceDiscovery.WatchServiceRoutes: proto definition https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/proto/openshell.proto#L873-L879; core server: https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/mod.rs, https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/v0.1.9/crates/openshell-server/src/grpc/service_discovery.rs
- The pattern to follow: the sub-client in openshell/v1/service_client.go, its types in openshell/v1/types/service.go, its converter in openshell/v1/internal/converter/service.go, and its fake in openshell/v1/fake/service.go.

Deliverables:

- Converters in openshell/v1/internal/converter/ that deep-copy slices and maps.

Done when `mise run ci` passes. Use Conventional Commits and sign off every commit.
````

rpcs.comment:
Allocate a gateway-owned staging slot for a local rootfs tar archive.

The gateway creates a request-scoped directory inside the compute driver's
staging root and returns an opaque single-use token plus the absolute path
the client must write the archive to. The token is then passed as
`template.driver_config.<driver>.rootfs_tar_staging_token` on
CreateSandbox; callers never name a filesystem path themselves. Only a
client sharing the gateway's filesystem can complete the upload.
